dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Sure thing! Say, why don't you take a look at my hat? Do you see anything different about it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Huh... Don't think there's any difference.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Ah, but that just means you need to look at it more carefully! Just come a bit closer.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: So, do you have the answer? Is it the pattern, or the color? You should have seen this hat many times before.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: *sigh* What a pity... Although, your conclusion is actually correct.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: I just played a little trick, and stole something of yours. And after that, I also slipped a card into your bag.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: Now, can you guess what I stole from you?

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: Haha, I really am quite the little thief with a nose for Mora! No wonder my pockets are always overflowing.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: What I actually stole, however, was your "attention." That's something far more valuable than Mora!

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: As long as you understand and master this trick, and put some time into practicing movement, you, too, can become an outstanding magician.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: ...Okay, you can return my card to me now.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: A most unexpected answer! I have to say, even my heart has begun to race too.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: What I actually stole, however, was your "attention." Even though it's not nearly as valuable as your heart, it's still very important to us magicians nonetheless!

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: Bingo! Congratulations, that was the right answer.

choices.text: Is it bigger or smaller than before?

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: No, the whole thing was misdirection.
